title: POTV ONE Advanced Accessories Kit
description:
Who is the “Advanced” Accessories Bundle for?

The POTV ONE Advanced Accessory Bundle is perfect for experienced users looking to upgrade their ONE experience with an upgraded accessory kit. It covers all the essentials you expect, along with a few extras you didn’t know you needed.

This bundle includes extra dosing capsules, travel caddies, a mini bubbler for cooler vapor on the go, an upgraded grinder, and more to enhance every session.

Need a bundle with the very best? Check out the Enthusiast Bundle.

POTV Curved Mini Bubbler

Cool your vapor on the go with the pocket-sized Curved Mini Bubbler. This mini bubbler connects directly to your POTV ONE and delivers portable, water-cooled vapor through a comfortable bent-neck mouthpiece for comfortable sessions wherever you are.

POTV 4 Piece Grinder

Grind and shred your herbs to perfection with a more durable and consistent shredder. The POTV 4 Piece Grinder comes with a grinding plate and lid, an herb catcher, and a bottom pollen catcher to collect the good stuff. Pollen scraper included.

The Scoop

Say goodbye to sticky fingers and messy loading with The Scoop, designed to keep your setup clean and your herbs untouched. This handy tool shovels the perfect amount with a wide-open scoop and tamps your loads with a flat side on the opposite end.

Two Sets of ONE Dosing Capsules (8)

Dosing capsules are a game-changer, which is why we’ve included two sets of ONE Dosing Capsules to keep your sessions going strong. Pre-pack several and enjoy back-to-back sessions with minimal downtime. These capsules are great for multiple sessions in rapid succession, nailing the perfect dose every time, and even help keep your vape cleaner for longer.

Comes with two sets of ONE Dosing Capsules for eight total.

Capsule Caddy, Caddy Insert, & Tightvac

Take your preloaded sessions on the go with the POTV ONE Dosing Caddy! This tough, metallic caddy holds up to four dosing capsules and keeps them secure with a smell-proof, waterproof seal. Just pack your capsules, stash them in the caddy, and use the keychain ring to attach it to your key ring, belt loop, or bag for easy travel.

Need more storage for a long trip? Place the Capsule Caddy Insert into our tightvac container and convert it into a dosing capsule organizer! This caddy insert comes with two numbered columns to hold and organize up to 12 total capsules, a center slot for stir tools or brushes, and a side slot for a boveda pack.

Two POTV ONE Concentrate Pads

One concentrate pad isn’t enough – the flavors mingle, and start to mix between different blends. These extras will give your concentrates the distinction they deserve, and keep the sessions rolling while the original pad is soaking clean.

Just load the pad inside the included dosing capsule, place a small amount of concentrate (no bigger than a grain of rice) onto the pad, and it’s good to go! Set the temperature to 430°F / 221°C and take long, slow sips once it vibrates.

For use with waxes and solid concentrates only. Use the included dosing capsule and only a very small amount (no bigger than a grain of rice) when vaporizing concentrates. Use with liquid concentrates may ruin your device and is not covered under warranty.

POTV ONE Replacement Screens and Alcohol Swabs

Keep your ONE running smoothly with a set of replacement screens. These screens sit under the glass adapter to keep herbs from entering the mouthpiece, but they’ll collect debris over time. A quick screen swap will save you from deep cleanings.

For tougher cleanups, use Snaps prefilled cotton swaps to clean a messy ONE oven chamber. Just snap the blue line end to release alcohol to the other side and wipe away stubborn residue.

Cleaning Disclaimer: DO NOT insert anything into the dimpled stem when cleaning. Clean with warm water and a mild grease-cutting dishwashing detergent such as Dawn or isopropyl alcohol.

Return policy

We do not accept used accessories returned on their own. However, your items are eligible for return through our 30-day policy if they are unused and unopened.
